evidence_limit: Archived inventory is an earlier snapshot, not a live filesystem census. Absence here means ingestion not verified, not proof a remote file does not exist.

sources.quality_contract: Preserve STARFLAG/ASPCAPFLAG, per-parameter PARAMFLAG, FE_H_FLAG and positive finite quoted errors; release-specific bit policy.
sources.dependency_contract: Released calibrated parameters; seismic gravity/temperature calibration and alternate reductions are dependencies, not independent observations.
sources.next_action: Retain raw/calibrated alternatives and element fields; DR19 analysis is a distinct version, not silently substituted.
sources.newer_public_analysis: SDSS DR20 carries APOGEE DR19 ASPCAP analysis/files unchanged. Our staged native source remains DR17; DR19/DR20 are not two independent analyses.

sources.quality_contract: Current publisher best practice: flag_sp==0 and snr_px_ccd3>30; ignore erroneous DR4 flag_fe_h. Element abundances require flag_X_fe==0. Preserve old policy separately.
sources.dependency_contract: Gravity uses external astrometric/photometric constraints; age/mass are model products. allspec repeats share reductions; no independent-count multiplication.
sources.next_action: Keep APOGEE and GALAH alternatives for overlapping Gaia IDs rather than precedence overwrite.

sources.quality_contract: Parse flags_gspspec character positions, individual abundance flags/upper limits, uncertainties and published calibration applicability; do not substitute rv_template_* or GSP-Phot.
sources.dependency_contract: Released atmospheric values uncalibrated; any published correction and its reference surveys must be versioned. RVS spectroscopy distinct from XP, but calibrated products may share reference surveys.
sources.next_action: Apply updated benchmark exclusions, retain original reference gauge, define fresh final groups, then fit new observation mapping; direct Fe/H unavailable in this sidecar

sources.quality_contract: Freeze archive version, instrument/setup, recommended parameters, uncertainties, flags, homogenisation/node provenance and cluster membership before activation.

sources.next_action: Resolve epoch/proper-motion-aware Gaia association and retain setup/quality columns before source activation

sources.quality_contract: Preserve convergence, spectral morphology, S/N, parameter errors and release-specific flags; separate pipeline selections.
sources.dependency_contract: BDASP uses Gaia DR2 priors; seismic-calibrated giant subset shares seismic anchors. Legacy filenames containing rave do not certify raw catalogue flags or lineage.
sources.next_action: Bind benchmark exclusions, role assignment and source-error/dependency model, then learn its observation mapping

sources.quality_contract: Star/success/primary, S/N, positive finite error, association and pipeline validity cuts; preserve RVTAB-SP TARGETID alignment. Existing low-metallicity RVTAB alpha policy excludes FEH<=-2 for primary use.
sources.dependency_contract: Two pipelines use common DESI spectra and are correlated; duplicate coadds/programs share observations. Gaia association is not guaranteed by TARGETID.
sources.next_action: Keep the existing raw RVSpecFit channel/reference gauge fixed during new-source mapping admission; FERRE alternatives stay separate
